origin: Manually calculated before candidate; checked by another agent without repository access; not generated by candidate.

additional_cases.joint_row_permutation: Training and validation joint permutations preserve per-ID predictions for the reference centroid; 3NN tie policy/order dependence is evaluated separately, not falsely required invariant at ties.
additional_cases.validation_perturbation: Replace V4 reading with 999; fit mean remains 2 and fit centroids remain unchanged. This perturbation prevents coincidentally unchanged means from hiding a leaky fit.
additional_cases.category_renaming: Bijective blue/red renaming with matching encoder mapping preserves semantic features/predictions. Unseen green stays [0,0].
additional_cases.ordinal_id_mutation: Change sample_id values/order while preserving row association; learned state/predictions for corresponding samples remain unchanged.

comparison_policy.float: compare derived means/distances/accuracy with abs_tol=1e-12; no fuzzy threshold decision boundary
comparison_policy.model_acceptance: centroid and 3NN controls both accepted; arbitrary alternatives judged by allowed inputs, actual fit, held-out evaluation and output contract, not exact centroid predictions
